question: Which of the following words refers to the misuse or violation of something that is considered sacred?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Desecration**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Desecration"** refers to the act of treating something sacred with disrespect or violation. (अपवित्रीकरण)
 
 
• **Example:** The desecration of the temple caused outrage among the community.
 
 
• **Explanation:** Desecration is used to describe the misuse, damage, or disrespect of something considered holy or sacred. (अपवित्र करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Writing graffiti on a church wall is an act of desecration.
